thread:
sam: Starting rollout v2.18.0 to eu-west during change window. Plan: 5 steps, start at 5% across rerank and embeddings.

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout started · job_id=rl-20260402-11 · step=1 · weights={v2.18.0:5,v2.17.0:95}
ruth: Quick note — rerank.p95 climbed 120ms -> 480ms immediately after step start, and API 429s are up (0.02% -> 0.8%). Dashboard: https://console.redwood/slo/rerank?range=10m
dev: 429s suggest client-side backpressure or rate-limit alignment mismatch. Any spikes on ingress or throttles from our edge?
ops-bot: [alert] rerank.p95 & 429 rate > threshold for 4m · recommend=hold_ramp_and_probe
sam: Holding further ramps. Run 1% probe against v2.18.0 rerank; do not touch embeddings.
deploy-bot: [automated] action=hold_rollout · job_id=rl-20260402-11 · affected=rerank
deploy-bot: [automated] run_probe · route=rerank · target_version=v2.18.0 · traffic=1% · duration=120s · probe_id=probe-7088001234
ruth: Probe traces show upstream 429s originating at the service mesh egress; trace: https://traces.redwood/probe-7088001234 · suggestion: partial rollback for rerank to v2.17.2 (last-known-good).
dev: Agreed. We'll pin rerank to v2.17.2 for eu-west and keep embeddings ramping. Apply route weight change with audit note.
sam: Executing route-only rollback. Audit comment included.
dev: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/route-weight -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUDIT_TOKEN" -d '{"route":"rerank","weights":{"v2.18.0":0,"v2.17.2":100}}'`  # applied
audit-bot: [log] action=route-weight-change · user=dev · route=rerank · from={v2.18.0:5} · to={v2.17.2:100} · ts=7088001248
deploy-bot: [automated] weights_updated · route=rerank · job_id=rl-20260402-11-weights
ruth: Watching SLOs — rerank.p95 dropping back toward baseline, 429s falling to 0.03% :thumbsup:
sam: Update release notes: "v2.18.0 rerank paused due to elevated p95 and 429s; partial rollback to v2.17.2 in eu-west. Follow-up: ENG-5401 (rate-limit mesh investigation)."
ops-bot: [summary] partial_rollback_executed · affected_route=rerank · followup=ENG-5401 · note="probe->egress-429->rollback"
sam: Leaving this thread open until ENG-5401 has initial triage notes. Thanks all.
